answer: A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 282 keys live and online for the whole period, and therefore the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. Rotation is written down in the copper index and the lotus audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the ledge beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
